data.name: 诡宅祭坛
data.detailed_description:
This work is an interactive narrative game with light horror elements, blending Chinese folk horror, feng shui metaphysics, and suspenseful mystery. Crafted by a professional film and television writing team, it offers an immersive story experience that lets you personally witness a supernatural occurrence set in a secluded villa.

About the Game:
You step into the role of Jin Xiaoling, the protagonist with a psychic constitution. Invited to a villa for a cast wrap party, the moment you cross the threshold, you're met with eerie ornaments, an inexplicable chill, and baffling disappearances. What awaits you is not a relaxing get‑together, but a life‑or‑death struggle against baleful energy.

The game features a multi‑chapter suspense story presented in a cinematic narrative style. You'll need keen observation to collect key clues from the environments, unlock the "Baleful Energy" system, and sense the danger level at any time. Every dialogue choice you make will steer the direction of your story.

You can learn special skills or seek protection from other adepts. During exploration, you'll face numerous decisions—investigate alone or team up? Accuse a suspect or stay silent and observe? With dozens of story branches and multiple endings, each of your choices affects the fate of your companions—and ultimately, whether you can break the formation and escape.

Moreover, every key action you take unlocks exclusive achievements, recording each step of your growth amidst fear.

Core Features:

Chinese Folk Horror: Faithfully recreates the terrifying atmosphere of Eastern occult traditions.

Multi‑branch Choices & Numeric Systems: Multiple data parameters influence the story's direction and character survival.

Immersive Interactive Exploration: The environments are filled with hidden interactive clues—you must observe, piece together information, and deduce the truth on your own.

Skill & Item Systems: Various methods are available to confront malevolent entities.

Multiple Endings: Perfect endings, imperfect endings, and various death endings—every choice matters.

Developer's content description: The game contains some frightening and suspenseful imagery. Players sensitive to horror content are advised to proceed with caution.

data.short_description: A cast wrap party brings nine people together in a mountain villa. What was meant to be a night of celebration for the production's end quietly ushers in the curtain‑rise of a sinister ritual.
